post.originalText:
Seedance 2.5. My black cat, one drop of water, five seconds of watching it fall.

Prompt: "He blinks once, slowly, and does not move"

Duration: 15s. Reference: one cutout. Rendered 480p, Topaz to 4K.

"The cat never flinches" is the consistency line. Every model wants the cat to react. Mine wouldn't. That's the part the reference can't teach, so the prompt has to.
